clue.text: King held within unleashed war dogs

indicators.note: the answer sits held inside the run of letters of the words that follow, across their word breaks

explanation.surface: Someone lets loose the dogs of war, a Shakespearean image of fighting breaking out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held within' tells you to look inside 'unleashED WARDogs'.
explanation.definitionFit: Several English monarchs bore this name, so it is an example of a king.

clue.text: Silver lining for heavenly ornament

indicators.note: the silver forms a lining on the inside of the heavenly word, so it goes within

parts.note: astral means of the stars, heavenly
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A play on the proverb that every cloud has a silver lining, applied to some celestial decoration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Silver lining' reads as the stock phrase, but 'lining' is the container signal and 'for' a mere link.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a small convex moulding used as decoration in architecture, so an ornament.

clue.text: GP's instrument?

parts.note: GP looks like a family doctor, whose instrument would be a stethoscope; but G and P are the abbreviations of the two words of the answer

explanation.surface: What tool does a general practitioner use?
explanation.walkthrough: GP suggests a doctor; read instead as g (grand) and p (piano), the abbreviations, and the instrument they make up is the large concert piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A large horizontal concert keyboard with strings laid flat, whose two words abbreviate to G and P.

clue.text: Mysterious and violent character in London park

definitions.meaning: Mr ..., Dr Jekyll's sinister alter ego in Stevenson's novella
the large royal park in central London

explanation.surface: A shady, violent figure is lurking in a London park.
explanation.walkthrough: HYDE PARK is a large royal park in central London.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are proper names: Stevenson's villain and the famous London park.

clue.text: Counsel uses pot scourer recklessly

indicators.note: used without care, the letters of the cleaning pad are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A lawyer carelessly uses a pan scrubber.
explanation.definitionFit: Counsel is a barrister or lawyer, and the one bringing a criminal case is this kind.

clue.text: Admirer's Cockney origin announced

indicators.note: said out loud, so the word for a Cockney birthplace is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a true Cockney is born within the sound of the bells of St Mary-le-Bow, so Bow is the Cockney's origin

explanation.surface: An admirer reveals where a Cockney comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a working-class Londoner, traditionally one born within earshot of Bow Bells in the City of London.
explanation.definitionFit: A beau is a suitor or boyfriend, someone who admires a woman.

clue.text: Perhaps first man to tour an independent republic

indicators.note: touring goes all round, so the first man's letters travel around the little word

parts.note: a man called Guy, labelled Guy A as if he were the first of several (Guy A, Guy B ...)

explanation.surface: Someone, perhaps a pioneer, sets off on a tour of a newly independent country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first man' tempts with ADAM; instead it is a fellow named Guy tagged A, as in Guy A and Guy B, and 'to tour' wraps him around the word.
explanation.definitionFit: This South American country gained independence from Britain in 1966 and is a republic.

clue.text: Border secured in record time — it won't last

indicators.note: the border is fixed inside the record and the time placed together

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
an era is a period of time
a hem is the border of a cloth

explanation.surface: A border captured in record time, yet the gain will be short-lived.
explanation.definitionFit: These are things of passing interest or short-lived usefulness, not meant to endure.

clue.text: Vandal sacked city in endless wasteland

indicators.note: the city goes inside the shortened wasteland
without its end, the final letter of the wasteland word drops

parts.note: a desert is a wasteland
Troy was the city sacked by the Greeks

explanation.surface: A vandal sacked a city in the middle of a vast wasteland, like a barbarian raider.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' drops the final T, leaving DESER, and the city goes 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A vandal is a wrecker, someone who wilfully damages things.

clue.text: England's leader saying be prepared

indicators.note: the leader of England is its first letter, the one at the head of the word

parts.note: a quip is a witty saying

explanation.surface: The England captain's motto is the Scout one, 'Be prepared'.
explanation.definitionFit: To fit out with what is needed, so as to make someone ready for a task.

clue.text: Settle in Scottish island for example after reflection

parts.note: Arran is an island in the Firth of Clyde

indicators.note: reflected as in a mirror, the abbreviation for 'for example' is seen backwards

explanation.surface: Someone decides to settle on a Scottish island, after some reflection.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle matters is to sort them out or organise them.

clue.text: Guru consuming country meat product

indicators.note: eating up, so the wise man holds the country inside

parts.note: a sage is a wise teacher, a guru
the USA is a country

explanation.surface: A spiritual teacher tucks into a rustic meat dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A banger is minced meat in a skin, a classic meat product.

clue.text: Party good to follow

parts.note: a do is a party

explanation.surface: A party that is good to go along to.
explanation.definitionFit: To trail or tail someone persistently, as a hound would.

clue.text: Caste tortured in elegant and repressive regime

indicators.note: the scrambled caste goes inside the elegant word

parts.note: polite in the sense of refined or elegant

indicators.note: twisted out of shape, so the letters of caste are mixed up

explanation.surface: A caste suffers torture within a polished but oppressive government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tortured' turns CASTE into CESTA, which goes 'in' POLITE.
explanation.definitionFit: A totalitarian state run through police control is a repressive regime.

clue.text: Sybarite returned to employment in another time

indicators.note: the reversed little word and the employment go inside the time word

parts.note: later is at another time

indicators.note: sent back, so the word to is read backwards

parts.note: use is employment, as in putting to use

explanation.surface: A pleasure-lover finally went back to work, some time later.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversed and employment pieces go 'in' after the first letter of the time word.
explanation.definitionFit: In Homer, eaters of the lotus fruit lived in idle luxury; a sybarite is a self-indulgent pleasure-seeker.

clue.text: Get out fast packing cold ready- cooked chicken

indicators.note: stuffing inside, so the departure word holds the cold and the cooked letters

parts.note: scat is a command to leave quickly

indicators.note: cooked up, so the letters of ready are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to clear off quickly while carrying cold ready-cooked chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' turns the letters of ready into AREDY; 'packing' puts that, after C, inside the dash word.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicken is slang for a coward, and a timid frightened person is just that.

clue.text: Once defiant island area with spirit

parts.note: malt whisky is a spirit

explanation.surface: An island that once stood firm is given a measure of courage and character.
explanation.walkthrough: This island withstood heavy siege in the Second World War and was awarded the George Cross for its defiance.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mediterranean island famously held out against wartime bombardment, so it is the once-defiant island.

clue.text: Sweet thing wheels round and round in chap's embrace

indicators.note: the chap holds them in his arms, so the other letters sit inside

parts.note: a chap is a man
wheels is slang for a car
O is round in shape
a second O, for the second round

explanation.surface: A car spins round and round as a fellow hugs it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a small almond biscuit or confection, a sweet treat.

clue.text: Add small measure

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both totting up figures and a small dram of liquor.

clue.text: Region accommodating new stadium

indicators.note: giving room to, so the region contains the new letter

parts.note: an area is a region

explanation.surface: A district finds room for a new sports ground.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is an enclosed space for sports or shows, so a stadium.

clue.text: Process involving choice when leaderless?

indicators.note: with its leader gone, the first letter of the choice word drops off

parts.note: a selection is a choice

explanation.surface: A vote is the procedure for making a choice when a country or party has no leader.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also works as a description: a vote is held when there is no incumbent.
explanation.definitionFit: A vote for office is a process of choosing candidates.

clue.text: Oriental style from one wearing trousers by lake

indicators.note: the one has the trousers on, so it goes inside them

parts.note: chinos are cotton trousers
I is the Roman numeral for one
Erie is one of the Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A look taken from someone in trousers standing by a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the European decorative style imitating Chinese motifs, an Oriental style.

clue.text: Do this to food for a laugh reportedly

indicators.note: as people say it, the phrase for a laugh is heard not spelt

parts.note: in jest means for a laugh

explanation.surface: An odd instruction to treat food as a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: To ingest is to swallow and take in, which is what one does with food.

clue.text: Peron was one rejecting farewell

indicators.note: turning back, so the Latin farewell is read backwards

parts.note: ave is Latin for hail or farewell

explanation.surface: Peron was someone who refused to say goodbye.
explanation.walkthrough: Eva Peron, Argentina's first lady, the 'Evita' of the musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Eva Peron bore this first name, so Peron was one example.

clue.text: Notes on string producing harmony

parts.note: A and C are musical notes
cord is a string

explanation.surface: Musical notes played on strings produce harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: Accord is agreement, being in harmony with someone.

clue.text: Little man on wagon entering AA meeting

parts.note: Reg, short for Reginald, is a shortened man's name

indicators.note: going into, so the teetotal letters go inside the two As

parts.note: on the wagon means teetotal, abbreviated TT

explanation.surface: A small man who has stopped drinking turns up at an Alcoholics Anonymous meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on wagon' sounds like transport but is the idiom for not drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A regatta is a meeting of boat races, a sporting fixture.

clue.text: Old marshal and sea god RN separately dismissed

indicators.note: both letters are removed one at a time from different places in the sea god

parts.note: Triton is a Greek god of the sea

explanation.surface: An old marshal and a sea god are both discharged from the Royal Navy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'separately dismissed' takes out the R and the N from TRITON. Tito was the Yugoslav leader and marshal.
explanation.definitionFit: Josip Broz, Yugoslavia's wartime leader, held the rank of marshal and died in 1980.

clue.text: Hidden clue here will be!

definitions.meaning: every clue in this puzzle is of this kind

explanation.definitionFit: The word means secret or obscure, and also names the kind of crossword clue being solved.

clue.text: Law lord who ran around departs

indicators.note: the runner lord goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: Lord Coe, the former Olympic middle-distance runner Sebastian Coe
D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: A judge who fled the court leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A code is a system of laws, such as a legal code.

clue.text: Working class making start

parts.note: on means functioning or working
a set is a class or group, as in school

explanation.surface: The working class is getting its start.
explanation.definitionFit: Onset is the beginning of something, its start.

clue.text: Challenger's replacement in determined attempt

definitions.meaning: the US space shuttle built to replace Challenger after its 1986 loss
an earnest effort or strenuous try

explanation.surface: Whoever replaces a challenger makes a determined attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: It names both the shuttle that replaced the lost Challenger and a strenuous effort.
